priorityList: Cast Mind Freeze to interrupt spellcasting targets.
Apply Reaper's Mark when Pillar of Frost is ready or nearly ready (within 1 GCD).
Use Pillar of Frost if Reaper's Mark is on cooldown or has just been applied.
Activate Breath of Sindragosa while Pillar of Frost is active.
Cast Remorseless Winter whenever available if multiple targets are present or to maintain Gathering Storm.
Use Frostwyrm's Fury near the end of Pillar of Frost or during Breath, provided Reaper's Mark and Exterminate are NOT currently active.
Use Empower Rune Weapon if you are low on Runes/Runic Power or to sustain Pillar of Frost/Breath of Sindragosa.
Cast Frostscythe when Killing Machine is active and there are 3 or more targets.
Cast Howling Blast on Rime procs to maintain Frost Fever or if Frostbound Will is talented.
Cast Frost Strike on targets with 5 stacks of Razorice if Frostbane is talented.
Use Obliterate if you have Killing Machine stacks but cannot use Frostscythe.
Cast Glacial Advance as your primary Runic Power spender in AoE situations.
Cast Frostscythe as a filler on 3 or more targets when not in Pillar of Frost.
Use Obliterate as a filler if Frostscythe is not preferred and you are not in your Pillar of Frost window.
Use active Trinkets, Potions, and Raise Dead during Pillar of Frost or Breath of Sindragosa for maximum burst.
